baseline_selection.selection_basis: Most complete worlds with raw score>=90 across both complete repeats; then completion; then mean with incomplete=0. No best-of-world aggregation.
baseline_selection.limitations: Best among these tested configurations; no claim of global or hidden-world optimality.
baseline_selection.selection_scope: Best among the two prompt configurations tested in this bounded study; not a global optimum.

protocol.study: E7: optional PySR after frozen no-extra-tool E6 selection
protocol.sequence: Publish the complete E6 baseline results before starting any E7 world. Synthetic setup tests are separate.

design.queue: interleave four arms/repeats by world across four identical 27B replicas; one active world per endpoint

report: each full batch scores, completion and raw>=90 count
per-world exploration, evaluation, total elapsed seconds
per-request mean and maximum output tokens with usage completeness
search calls, actual elapsed, completed axes, candidate adoption evidence
keep every failure and do not claim hidden-world generalization

definitions.score: Original valid score retained even when evaluation_complete=false. Selection metric separately treats incomplete evaluations as zero. These are public development worlds, not official hidden-world scores.
definitions.timing: 300 seconds covers exploration including model and scientific tools; post-session evaluation and total elapsed are reported separately.
definitions.usage: A full-session average is reported only with complete finalized request usage. Max reported output is not a full-session guarantee when usage is missing.
definitions.adoption: Exact law AST and named parameter_spec match with a later fit; adopted_submitted additionally matches accepted law_id. Unmatched/rewritten candidates remain unknown, not proof of non-use.
definitions.scope: First symbolic tool is state/probe-property only with no body-position features. Model seed unfixed; fixed symbolic seed does not ensure GPU/CPU bitwise reproducibility. No best-of-world combination across repeats.

manual_symbolic_adoption_summary.basis: All three complete search result records, subsequent fit arguments, accepted law IDs, and public progress messages inspected. Each run rejected the returned candidates; this manual finding is stronger than the generic exact-match-only unknown field.
manual_symbolic_adoption_summary.indirect_effect: Possible indirect influence cannot be causally separated. The on R02 world3 96-point submission was a separately proposed linear law, not a returned SR candidate.
manual_symbolic_adoption_summary.search_deadline_semantics: All three searches returned ok=true/status=timeout, both axes and three checkpoint candidates; this is a bounded search result, not an HTTP failure or exploration timeout.

conclusion.point_estimate: No improvement demonstrated in this registered 2-off/2-on experiment. Off has 3/12 complete raw scores >=90 and selection mean 45.1606; on has 2/12 and selection mean 31.0656.
conclusion.repeat_variability: Off batch means 67.1098 and 23.2113 differ substantially; two repeats do not establish a reliable causal performance difference.
conclusion.causal_scope: The intervention enables an optional state/probe-property SR tool and its description. Only 3 of 12 on sessions invoked it. This is not a forced-use benchmark of the symbolic backend, a body-aware SR benchmark, or evidence about nine hidden test worlds.
conclusion.no_posthoc_selection: Both complete six-world repeats retained; no best-world stitching or re-run replacement.
